description: Use to onboard an EXTERNAL builder's x402 service into the Nevermined Agent Services Catalog end-to-end: check the service exposes the metadata a listing needs, pick the routable endpoint, validate it actually charges and works by paying it directly from a wallet (raw EOA + EIP-3009), register the agent, publish + promote the listing, then run a real paid e2e THROUGH the Nevermined Router. Also covers an ownerless, Nevermined-curated listing the real operator can CLAIM later, and when a listed service becomes payable in Nevermined credits (not only from a Delegation). Trigger phrases: "enroll a service in the catalog", "onboard an external builder", "a merchant wants to add their x402 service", "list and validate an x402 service", "add <service> to the Nevermined Catalog", "claim a catalog listing".

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent implement the requested change with minimal unrelated edits?
Did the agent verify behavior changes instead of relying on intuition?
